cat > /root/recovery_aware_struct_prune/src/run_mvp.sh << 'SCRIPT_EOF'
#!/bin/bash
# RASP MVP Experiment
# cuda:0 + cuda:1 parallel where possible
set -e

PROJECT_ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." && pwd)"
cd "$PROJECT_ROOT"

mkdir -p results models

echo "=========================================="
echo "RASP MVP Experiment"
echo "=========================================="

# Step 1+2: CKA (cuda:0) + Importance (cuda:1) — parallel
echo "[Step 1+2/6] Computing CKA overlap + importance scores (parallel)..."
CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 python3 src/cka_overlap.py \
  --model_path models/DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B \
  --output_path results/cka_scores.pt \
  --n_samples 512 &
PID_CKA=$!

CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=1 python3 src/importance_score.py \
  --model_path models/DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B \
  --output_path results/importance_scores.pt \
  --n_samples 512 &
PID_IMP=$!

wait $PID_CKA || { echo "CKA FAILED with exit code $?"; exit 1; }
wait $PID_IMP || { echo "IMPORTANCE FAILED with exit code $?"; exit 1; }
echo "CKA + Importance complete."

# Step 3: Pruning — parallel on 2 GPUs
echo "[Step 3/6] Pruning models..."
CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 python3 src/prune.py \
  --model_path models/DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B \
  --importance_path results/importance_scores.pt \
  --mode standard --sparsity 0.35 \
  --output_path models/pruned_standard_35 &
PID_STD=$!

CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=1 python3 src/prune.py \
  --model_path models/DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B \
  --importance_path results/importance_scores.pt \
  --cka_path results/cka_scores.pt \
  --mode rasp --sparsity 0.35 --alpha 1.0 \
  --output_path models/pruned_rasp_35 &
PID_RASP=$!

wait $PID_STD || { echo "STANDARD PRUNE FAILED with exit code $?"; exit 1; }
wait $PID_RASP || { echo "RASP PRUNE FAILED with exit code $?"; exit 1; }
echo "Pruning complete."

# Step 3.5: Post-prune eval — parallel on 2 GPUs
echo "[Step 3.5/6] Post-prune evaluation..."
CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 python3 src/eval_gsm8k.py \
  --model_path models/pruned_standard_35 \
  --output_path results/eval_pruned_standard_35.json &
PID_EVAL_STD=$!

CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=1 python3 src/eval_gsm8k.py \
  --model_path models/pruned_rasp_35 \
  --output_path results/eval_pruned_rasp_35.json &
PID_EVAL_RASP=$!

wait $PID_EVAL_STD || { echo "POST-PRUNE EVAL STANDARD FAILED with exit code $?"; exit 1; }
wait $PID_EVAL_RASP || { echo "POST-PRUNE EVAL RASP FAILED with exit code $?"; exit 1; }
echo "Post-prune eval complete."

# Step 4: GRPO RLVR Recovery — parallel on 2 GPUs
echo "[Step 4/6] GRPO RLVR recovery training..."
CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 python3 src/train_grpo.py \
  --model_path models/pruned_standard_35 \
  --output_path models/recovered_standard_35 \
  --gpu 0 &
PID_TRAIN_STD=$!

CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=1 python3 src/train_grpo.py \
  --model_path models/pruned_rasp_35 \
  --output_path models/recovered_rasp_35 \
  --gpu 1 &
PID_TRAIN_RASP=$!

wait $PID_TRAIN_STD || { echo "GRPO STANDARD FAILED with exit code $?"; exit 1; }
wait $PID_TRAIN_RASP || { echo "GRPO RASP FAILED with exit code $?"; exit 1; }
echo "GRPO recovery complete."

# Step 5: Post-recovery eval — parallel on 2 GPUs
echo "[Step 5/6] Evaluating recovered models on GSM8K..."
CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 python3 src/eval_gsm8k.py \
  --model_path models/recovered_standard_35 \
  --output_path results/eval_recovered_standard_35.json &
PID_EVAL_REC_STD=$!

CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=1 python3 src/eval_gsm8k.py \
  --model_path models/recovered_rasp_35 \
  --output_path results/eval_recovered_rasp_35.json &
PID_EVAL_REC_RASP=$!

wait $PID_EVAL_REC_STD || { echo "POST-RECOVERY EVAL STANDARD FAILED with exit code $?"; exit 1; }
wait $PID_EVAL_REC_RASP || { echo "POST-RECOVERY EVAL RASP FAILED with exit code $?"; exit 1; }

# Step 6: Correlation Analysis
echo "[Step 6/6] Running correlation analysis..."
CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 python3 src/correlation_analysis.py \
  --base_model_path models/DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B \
  --pruned_model_path models/pruned_rasp_35 \
  --recovered_model_path models/recovered_rasp_35 \
  --cka_scores_path results/cka_scores.pt \
  --pruning_mask_path models/pruned_rasp_35/pruning_metadata.pt \
  --output_dir results/analysis/ \
  --n_gqa_groups 4 \
  --n_mlp_groups 28 \
  --n_samples 256

echo "=========================================="
echo "MVP Experiment Complete"
echo "=========================================="
echo "Results:"
echo "  Pruned Standard:    results/eval_pruned_standard_35.json"
echo "  Pruned RASP:        results/eval_pruned_rasp_35.json"
echo "  Recovered Standard: results/eval_recovered_standard_35.json"
echo "  Recovered RASP:     results/eval_recovered_rasp_35.json"
echo "  Correlation:        results/analysis/correlation_results.json"
python3 -c "
import json
for name, path in [('Pruned Std', 'results/eval_pruned_standard_35.json'),
                   ('Pruned RASP', 'results/eval_pruned_rasp_35.json'),
                   ('Recovered Std', 'results/eval_recovered_standard_35.json'),
                   ('Recovered RASP', 'results/eval_recovered_rasp_35.json')]:
    with open(path) as f:
        d = json.load(f)
    print(f'  {name}: {d[\"accuracy\"]:.4f} ({d[\"n_correct\"]}/{d[\"n_total\"]})')
with open('results/analysis/correlation_results.json') as f:
    d = json.load(f)
print(f'  Correlation: rho={d[\"combined\"][\"spearman_rho\"]:.4f}, p={d[\"combined\"][\"p_value\"]:.2e}, verdict={d[\"mvp_verdict\"]}')
"
SCRIPT_EOF
chmod +x /root/recovery_aware_struct_prune/src/run_mvp.sh
echo "run_mvp.sh written OK"
